answer_1.quote: Question generation (QG) aims to endow machines with the ability to ask relevant and to-the-point questions about a document.

answer_2.quote: we employ BLEU, ROUGE-L and METEOR as automated evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: we further randomly sample 300 examples in the test set for human evaluation... we ask three workers to rate the 300 generated questions as well as the ground-truth questions between 1 (poor) and 5 (good) on three criteria: (1) fluency, (2) relevance, (3) complexity.
answer_4.guideline: Workers rate each question on a 1‑5 scale for fluency, relevance, and complexity.
